title: Dereth Town Tour - Neydisa Castle scratch

shots.standingOrder: Hang wide and high north-east of the spired castle and drift slowly, the Esper mountains behind; stay 15 m above every treetop.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING. Wide, high and slow from the north-east (170 m out, 48 m up, z 148): the compact Empyrean castle on its grassy shelf - keep spire (z 131.5), spired corner towers, red banners - drifting 12 deg with a 10% push, the Esper mountains rising beyond to the south-west, morning sun from behind-left. Verified: AGL 60.5-65.4, nearest default scenery 39.7 m, retail 7.3 m (a 13 m pine top), no statics.

shots.standingOrder: Carve in from the south-east and thread the gap between the twin Empyrean spires along the road, then race on toward the castle; keep 5 m from both towers and 3 m above the road.
shots.notes: HERO FPV (JEV candidate if the budget allows; code is safe). Carves in from the south-east and threads the gap between the twin 30.75 m Empyrean spires that flank the road 260 m east of the castle (gate at 28956, 41160, z 94), then flies straight on along the road toward Neydisa Castle, which fills the end of the frame. Spire bodies are +-5.5 m (eave +-7 at 18 m, above the lens), so the 13 m gap leaves 6.5 m each side at the crossing (mesh-verified at t 5.5). Verified: AGL 9.6 -> 2.8 (WBT ground 84.36 -> 91.17), scenery >= 14.7 m, vmax 10.9 m/s (fpv preset).

shots.standingOrder: Truck north along the sunlit east wall at walking pace, 12 m off the stones and 2 m up; nothing between lens and wall.
shots.notes: FACADE PAN (2 of 2 in this batch): Empyrean castle wall. Pure lateral truck 34 m north along x 28731.9, 12 m off the sunlit east curtain wall, lens 2.3 m above the lawn and tilted 6 deg up: the spired south-east tower, the 6 m wall and its north-east corner slide past while the keep's spire and the red banners rise behind; morning sun straight onto the wall. Lawn between wall and the eastern grove verified empty: no static or scenery within 12.1 m of the camera line (default scenery 18.8 m, retail 13.7 m), ground 100.0 -> 99.5 (WBT). vmax 4.5 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Push slowly toward the menhir ring and its rising blue glow with the pine grove behind; stay 5 m outside the stones.
shots.notes: FX: MENHIR RING. 250 m west of the castle on the spire hill, a ring of eight 3.5 m menhirs encircles the 'Chemical Reaction' emitter 0x0200067B (catalog 0x320003E9: 26 blue glow clouds swarming up and swelling to 8 m over 10 s). Slow push from 24 m to 13 m out of the north-north-east, 10 deg down, into the blue mist with the pine grove behind. Verified: AGL 10.9 -> 7.7 (WBT 128.16 -> 129.08), ends 5.1 m from the nearest menhir; default scenery 2.9 m from the AABB corner of a scale-2.8 pine whose trunk is 29 m away (crown radius ~22 m); this spot assumes the default scenery bake - with ?sceneryBake=retail the ring sits inside a dense grove.

shots.standingOrder: Look straight down into the courtyard and climb away, the Life Stone and portal shrinking as the spired castle and its towers turn below; keep 10 m above the keep spire.
shots.notes: CLOSING TOP-DOWN RISE. Nadir view 22 m above the courtyard (z 122) - the Town Network swirl, the Life Stone's sparkle in the north-east corner, the two courtyard trees, candelabra flames - climbing to z 200 while the image turns 50 deg, so the spired towers, keep spire and curtain walls close around the courtyard and the shelf opens up. Verified: camera column x 28694 y 41172 is 19 m north of the keep spire tip (z 131.5) and 11.9 m from the courtyard tree tops; AGL 22 -> 100; vmax 9.4 m/s.
